scenes.title: Why Hardware-Backed Passkeys?
scenes.caption: Phishing attacks are on the rise.

voiceover: Did you know your ChatGPT account could be at risk? Here's how to protect it! OpenAI just mandated hardware-backed passkeys for all Trusted Access Cyber members... Why? Because phishing attacks are on the rise... So, what exactly are passkeys? They're a more secure alternative to passwords, making it harder for attackers to gain access... Transitioning to passkeys is simple! Just head to chatgpt.com, access Advanced Account Security, and choose your YubiKey... Once you enable that hardware-backed passkey, you can enjoy a passwordless login experience... This is crucial for raising the bar on security... So, secure your account now! Get your YubiKeys today!
captions: Phishing attacks are on the rise.
